provenance.source: The earlier native validation returned JSON through the execution tool. No fixed raw stdout file was saved; the values below are copied from that tool result.
provenance.limitation: This is an excerpt of an actual earlier run in this session, not a SHA-bound raw run record. Final source received subsequent reporting/deadline/close refinements. These numbers are not claimed as a new run against the final frozen source.

finalSourceSnapshot.binding: frozen source snapshot at evidence save; not an exact native-run source binding

fixture.target: one explicitly owned synthetic Node child process
fixture.busyLoop: approximately 70 milliseconds of work per 100 millisecond timer period

measurementScope.cpu: own user plus system counters; child CPU counters are not added
measurementScope.rssPeak: maximum of the registered PID set RSS sum at each observed sample
excluded: WKWebView XPC without verified parent ancestry

proven: the earlier Darwin run sampled RSS and cumulative CPU for its one owned synthetic Node target
the observed CPU delta agreed closely with the target's own process.cpuUsage counters
the target start identity remained stable across the observed samples
after target exit the sampler rejected both the first and repeated read
excluded: a SHA-bound reproducible raw execution record
a native rerun of every final frozen source byte
an EastGenesis app or full WebView process-tree resource measurement
startup time or UI readiness measurement
